in_marathi.name: Aja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Aja is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ajah’ which means ‘not born’. This name is often used for gods and heroes who were self-created or born from a divine being. In Hindu mythology, Aja is also known as the father of the first man, Manu. The name signifies the power of creation and vitality.
